description: Level-3 MOM ProcessSegment (ISA-95 Part 2 / B2MML ProcessSegment). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/process-segment.md, description.

properties.name: process_segment_no
properties.description: Identity of the ProcessSegment (join key). Recommendation: path- / Function-prefixed, since Function codes are unique per line.

properties.name: process_segment_code
properties.description: Raw segment / Function code from the naming source (the function naming standard Table 1 / the MES 'plant' code).

properties.name: name
properties.description: Display name of the manufacturing stage (e.g. a forming, dosing, or curing stage).

properties.name: operations_type
properties.description: ISA-95 'Mixed Operation Schedule' classification of the stage. Corresponds to the momDomain.

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: Sequence of the stage within the OperationsDefinition (routing).

properties.name: duration_planned_sec
properties.description: Planned stage duration (s) as a capability default; overridden by the SegmentRequirement in the concrete order.

properties.name: operations_definition_ref
properties.description: FK to OperationsDefinition.operations_definition_no (PART_OF). The routing to which this stage belongs.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: unit_ref
properties.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ Unit level). The ISA-88 Unit / process stage on which the segment runs — the physical anchoring of the 'plant' / 'Function'.

properties.name: depends_on_process_segment_ref
properties.description: The ProcessSegment (DEPENDS_ON; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → ProcessSegment). Optional.

properties.name: parent_process_segment_ref
properties.description: The ProcessSegment this ProcessSegment is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 ProcessSegment MADE_UP_OF ProcessSegment). Optional.

properties.name: equipment_class_ref
properties.description: The EquipmentClass (SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → EquipmentClass). Optional.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The MaterialClass (SPECIFIES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → MaterialClass). Optional.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: The Article (SPECIFIES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → MaterialDefinition). Optional.

properties.name: material_lot_ref
properties.description: The MaterialLot (SPECIFIES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → MaterialLot). Optional.

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (SPECIFIES_MATERIAL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The Person (SPECIFIES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → Person). Optional.

properties.name: personnel_class_ref
properties.description: The PersonnelClass (SPECIFIES_PERSONNEL; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → PersonnelClass). Optional.

properties.name: tool_ref
properties.description: The Tool (SPECIFIES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → PhysicalAsset). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (SPECIFIES_PHYSICAL_ASSET; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 ProcessSegment → TestSpecification). Optional.

relationships.description: The Machine (≡ Unit level, consolidation 2026-07-15; = plant = Function) on which the segment is executed.

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 2 ProcessSegment = reusable manufacturing stage. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/process-segment.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML carries a duration on OperationsSegment and SegmentRequirement, not on ProcessSegment. process_segment_code is the raw code of the naming source; B2MML ProcessSegment names no routing and no position in one (OperationsSegment carries the routing). Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
